description: Shorten a public website for easy typing on a TV remote, console browser, phone or computer. Returns a short preview URL, four digits, one-hour idle expiry and instructions. Free beta, no account or API key. Appropriate for temporary device handoff; not permanent bookmarks, private links, casting or sign-in transfer. Publishes the submitted URL behind a guessable code. Requires a fresh random UUID request_id; reuse the same URL and ID for retries. Five new attempts per network daily and shared beta capacity; do not evade limits.

request_id.description: Generate a fresh random UUID for a new logical request. Retain it and the exact URL for retries. This is a request identifier, not an API key.

url.description: The public website the user wants to share. Bare domains default to HTTPS. Never submit private URLs or access tokens.

name: create_short_link
title: Create a short URL with a four-digit TV code
